message.content:
Wool-blend structured blazer in charcoal grey (#3D405B), tailored fit with soft shoulder lines, knee-length hemline.
Relaxed-fit trousers in stone beige (#E8E6DB), wide-leg cut for fluid movement, ankle length.
Silk blouse in muted olive green (#5F7161), boat neckline and boxy silhouette, hip-length tunic style.
Leather loafers in oxblood red (#7A2332), pointed toe with a low block heel.
Minimalist gold bar necklace with 2mm width, paired with thin hoop earrings in polished brass.

This ensemble honors the "neat" dress code while subtly directing attention away from the belly through a relaxed trouser fit and a slightly oversized blouse that creates vertical lines without cinching at the waist. The structured blazer adds necessary polish for an office environment, while the soft stone and muted olive tones bring warmth appropriate for autumn weather without relying on an outer layer. A splash of deep red in the shoes injects creative energy suitable for a modern workspace, ensuring the look remains comfortable yet refined throughout the workday.
